system.gmNotes:
Example: Victory Points. Built for four level-3 PCs. The base DC is 18, level 3's DC.

The weir above the mill village is cracking in a storm. The PCs have four rounds of about ten minutes before the flood comes. Each PC acts once a round on either subject.

Each roll: a success gives the subject 1 Victory Point, a critical success 2, and a critical failure takes 1 away. Use + and − on its counter. The thresholds say what each total buys.

At the end of round 4: read the reached thresholds. Shore the Weir at 6 means the weir holds. Evacuate the Mill at 5 means everyone got out. Fewer means damage or people still inside, as the threshold text says.

Spare Timbers is an opportunity: turn it On when a PC searches the mill yard (no roll needed). It is spent on the next Crafting check against the weir.

modifiers.name: Driving Rain
modifiers.description: Wind and rain lash the dam. Every check takes a −1 circumstance penalty.

subjects.name: Shore the Weir
subjects.description: Water pours through a widening crack in the old stone weir. Brace it before it gives way.

thresholds.name: The crack stops widening
thresholds.description: The weir will hold for now, but the lower fields flood.

thresholds.name: The weir holds
thresholds.description: The water drops back behind the stones. The village is safe.

modifiers.name: Spare Timbers
modifiers.description: Seasoned beams from the mill yard make the props easier to fit.
modifiers.note: Turn On when a PC searches the mill yard.

actions.name: Check
actions.description: Brace the stones with Athletics, or shape timbers into props with Crafting. A success earns 1 Victory Point; a critical success earns 2; a critical failure loses 1.

subjects.name: Evacuate the Mill
subjects.description: The miller's family and their workers are still inside, arguing about what to save.

thresholds.name: Everyone is out
thresholds.description: The last of the workers runs clear with the mill's ledgers.

actions.name: Check
actions.description: Talk them out with Diplomacy, order them out with Intimidation, or carry them out with Athletics. A success earns 1 Victory Point; a critical success earns 2; a critical failure loses 1.
